hooks.command: if command -v peachycheck >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec peachycheck hook post-edit; else echo '{"systemMessage": "peachycheck is not on PATH; its post-edit hook is skipped"}'; fi
if command -v peachycheck >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec peachycheck hook stop; else echo '{"systemMessage": "peachycheck is not on PATH; its stop hook is skipped"}'; fi
